items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Who else was in that saxophone section in the Celestan band? ... Yeah, he's been with Eddie Pierce too. ... He's a saxophone player.

ctx.x: Who else was in that saxophone section in the Celestan band? Do you remember who else was in the band?
When I was playing? Yeah. Yeah. A Sydney career and I can't think of Pierce's last name. Yeah, he's been with Eddie Pierce too. Not the trombone player, I must be. He's a saxophone player.
Is he any kind to Earl Pearson? Earl Pierce, yeah, that's what it is.
